name: Analytic Ray-Intersection Polynomial Solver
definition: A method to find intersections near the surface by solving for the parameter $t$ where the ray intersects the polynomial approximation of the SDF leaf node. This avoids the slow convergence of sphere marching near the surface.
summary: The Analytic Ray-Intersection Polynomial Solver computes exact ray intersections with polynomial SDF approximations, offering significant performance improvements over iterative sphere marching near parallel surfaces.
